metadata.syllabus_name: AI, Data Science with Python & SQL - TTNT, KHDL với Python và SQL
metadata.course_name_english: AI, Data Science with Python & SQL
metadata.description: The course covers relational database concepts, foundational knowledge of the SQL language. The students will learn some popular tools for data science, understand a methodology that can be used within data science, meet some data science practitioner, understand data gathering, summarize data using descriptive statistics, display and visualize data.
metadata.tools:
Jupyter Notebooks
- JupyterLab
- RStudio IDE
- Git, GitHub
-Watson Studio.

clos.clo_details: Understand relational database concepts, and foundational knowledge of the SQL language.
Define an overview of what data science is today.
Know tools for Data Science, know how to use at least one tool for Data Science
Understand why we are interested in data science, what a methodology is, and why data scientists need a methodology.
Discusses Python fundamentals, python libraries, API suport for data science
Explain the statistics for Data Science: mean, median, mode, variance, and standard deviation, data visualization, regression analysis
Implement the small data science project by applying Python fundamentals, and Python data structures, and working with data in Python.
